contentPattern: FAQ tabs: a centered row of tabs, each a circular illustration above a label (e.g. 'Getting started', 'Earnings & rewards', 'Eligibility', 'General'), active tab underlined. Each tab's panel is a bordered, rounded box of collapsible Q&A items (bold question with a chevron on the right, thin dividers, answer expands on click). Authored as rows of tab (image + label) | question | answer (an empty tab cell continues the previous tab), or tab | panel content with each question as a heading or bold paragraph.
